import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/skills/toolsandbox-assistant")
import os
os.environ["TOOLSANDBOX_ASSISTANT_DB"] = "/workspace/world.db"
from tools import main as tools_main
from io import StringIO

def call_tool(name, args_dict):
    old_argv = sys.argv
    old_stdout = sys.stdout
    sys.argv = ["tools.py", name, "--json", json.dumps(args_dict)]
    buf = StringIO()
    sys.stdout = buf
    try:
        tools_main()
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    finally:
        sys.stdout = old_stdout
        sys.argv = old_argv
    return buf.getvalue()

ts_out = call_tool("get_current_timestamp", {})
print("timestamp:", ts_out)
ts_data = json.loads(ts_out)
now_ts = ts_data["result"]

dt_out = call_tool("timestamp_to_datetime_info", {"timestamp": now_ts})
dt_data = json.loads(dt_out)
info = dt_data["result"]
